context:
# Goal
Advise the sole lore L1 on one r86 calibration move: expose ambiguous provenance-holder references and the permanently unassessed continuity/tick-order tail without choosing identities or changing comparisons. Baseline 5eb9451baff217c19d5786405f9b2aa500b7c1b7; inherited candidate corpus/fixtures/check_bible.py. Read .ufo/rounds/r86/wwkd-plan.md and the named slice before reasoning.
# Contract
Only writable repository: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/lore-shokunin. Each member owns only its renderer-named report; all code, corpus, fixtures, LOG, SCORECARD and other reports are read-only. Parent owns shared-file integration. LEAF: no delegation, child processes for orchestration, background jobs, tests, builds, lint or formatters. Static evidence only while wave is in flight; specify exact parent-run acceptance scenarios. No push, commits, routing/config changes, native transcript reads, secrets, external research or substrate remediation. Report exact file/line evidence, consumer-visible risk, no-change recommendation when justified, and limits. These are advisory reports, never native judgment, promotion or outside discernment review. Required existing route bindings: content/scribe @m_composer; scout/review/critic @m_grok; connector @m_antigravity with @m_zfl fallback. If actual route cannot meet that requirement, report the missing binding; do not substitute. The L1 must gate route authorization before dispatch.

items.name: ToHolder
items.prompt: Audit only the to_holder duplicate-count branch in check_bible.py and r85 masked input. Identify exact local reference finding, invalidity and notice location; distinguish absent from duplicated holder. Do not review from_holder symmetry here.

items.name: FromHolder
items.prompt: Audit only from_holder duplicate-count handling and null/empty-type boundary. Give a concrete symmetric-from scratch scenario and the expected preserved latch. Do not duplicate to_holder branch review.

items.name: BothFields
items.prompt: Analyze a record where from_holder and to_holder each resolve ambiguously, using different duplicated IDs. Determine whether both local paths are disclosed but the record emits one notice; supply a falsifier.

items.name: FirstRecord
items.prompt: Analyze holder ambiguity at provenance[0] with a non-null from_holder. Check that no first-record continuity claim is invented after invalidity; distinguish a definite malformed start from an unassessed comparison.

items.name: TailContinuity
items.prompt: Analyze the permanent latch with two individually valid records after the ambiguous record and a later discontinuity. Determine whether updating previous_holder can illicitly resume comparison; cite state assignments.

items.name: TailTicks
items.prompt: Analyze the permanent latch using two valid later records with non-increasing ticks. Distinguish tick field validity from cross-record tick-order assessment; specify a parent smoke falsifier.

items.name: PrefixBreak
items.prompt: Inspect whether a definite chain break before the first ambiguous record remains reported. Define prefix evidence that the notice cannot retroactively erase or relabel.

items.name: PrefixTick
items.prompt: Inspect whether a definite tick-order inversion before ambiguity remains reported. Identify message qualification and order preservation independently of prefix continuity.

items.name: PriorNonobject
items.prompt: Map the non-object provenance-record early continue before a later holder ambiguity. Show which state has already stopped and whether the new notice wording falsely locates the first stop.

items.name: PriorWrongKeys
items.prompt: Map a wrong-key-set provenance record followed by a later ambiguous holder. Check early validation boundaries: do not mine malformed holder-like payloads for new local findings.

items.name: BadTickSameRow
items.prompt: Analyze an ambiguous-holder record with a negative or boolean tick. Determine retained field-local invalidity, one notice, and diagnostic order without conflating invalid tick shape with tick-order comparison.

items.name: DanglingTo
items.prompt: Read the to_holder zero-count branch and existing fixtures. State exact preservation requirements for a dangling destination and why a holder-ambiguity notice is not owed when no duplicate is present.

items.name: DanglingFrom
items.prompt: Read the from_holder zero-count branch and existing provenance controls. State exact preservation requirements for missing origin versus allowed null acquisition; avoid duplicate to_holder analysis.

items.name: InvalidHolderTypes
items.prompt: Analyze non-string, whitespace and boolean holder inputs against existing type guards. Determine whether the candidate can access an unsafe count key or emit an ambiguity notice for an unvalidated field.

items.name: RepeatedAmbiguity
items.prompt: Analyze repeated ambiguous references across several records of one item. Require every traversed local field error but only one notice at the first ambiguous record; identify any suppression risk.

items.name: IndependentItems
items.prompt: Analyze two item entities, each with an ambiguous holder, and a third unique broken chain. Determine whether per-item notice and comparison state reset without leaking between items.

items.name: OwnItemDuplicate
items.prompt: Analyze duplicate IDs for the item itself rather than its holders. Check existing initial chain eligibility and avoid claiming the new holder notice covers every cause of non-assessment.

items.name: NonitemProvenance
items.prompt: Analyze provenance attached to a character/place/faction. Preserve the existing only-valid-on-item error and false initial comparison gate; identify any notice overstatement without widening implementation.

items.name: SourcesUnavailable
items.prompt: Map provenance behavior when sources.json is unavailable or malformed. Distinguish source availability gating from holder ambiguity and state how a mixed-input notice must be interpreted.

items.name: SourceUnknown
items.prompt: Map an unknown source_id before a later ambiguous holder. Verify permanent invalidity and continued record-level checks; ensure disclosure does not imply holder ambiguity was the sole original blocker.

items.name: SourceAmbiguous
items.prompt: Compare duplicated source citation behavior with duplicated holder identity. Use r7-item-ambiguous and input-structural qualification; reject a refactor that incorrectly merges their eligibility rules.

items.name: UnreferencedDuplicate
items.prompt: Analyze a duplicated entity ID never referenced by provenance holders. Require global duplicate reporting but no holder notice; distinguish duplicate existence from a consumed ambiguous reference.

items.name: DuplicatePermutation
items.prompt: Analyze duplicate-holder row permutations with different entity kinds/claims. Check that counts, not last indexed duplicate payload, control ambiguity and no duplicate identity is selected.

items.name: UniqueControls
items.prompt: Compare clean and unique-holder broken item chains against baseline. Identify exact exit/stdout/stderr preservation and why a checker disabling all provenance comparisons must fail acceptance.

items.name: CollateralChecks
items.prompt: Audit relation, timeline and contradiction checks for collateral loss after the narrow holder addition. Use r85-harbor-repro as the overlapping timeline-ambiguity witness; do not claim source truth.

items.name: LegacyReplay
items.prompt: Partition all inherited fixture replay expectations: exact unchanged tuples versus legitimate additional holder disclosures. Specify an auditable comparison that fails on lost prior findings and avoids promising zero differences without measurement.

items.name: InputPreservation
items.prompt: Define immutable fictional JSON path/byte preservation against 5eb9451 and separately label new reports and temporary probes. Inspect current fixture inventories; do not read native sessions or change any inputs.

items.name: CliContract
items.prompt: Audit CLI exit 0/1, VIOLATION prefixes, violation-count footer and stderr behavior under added notices. Explain why a count remains findings rather than underlying defect cardinality.

items.name: ReaderBoundary
items.prompt: Challenge the candidate's editorial claim using r85 sealed review. Does visible non-assessment change a stopping decision, or merely navigation? Bound mechanical output proof separately from unperformed blinded reader evidence.

items.name: GuideAudit
items.prompt: Audit inherited holder-assessment-boundary.md for unsupported runtime claims, dangling measure_holder_disclosure.py references, wrong round-1 authority and whole-axis score implications. Return exact corrections as advice only; preserve authored bytes.

items.name: LearningRecord
items.prompt: Specify truthful r86 per-axis and learning-trend reporting under route blockage. Separate historical admitted r85, interrupted nine-seat evidence, unknown verified-round total, missing lane contracts, and absence of outside spot-check. No progress or promotion inflation.

items.name: BoundaryConnector
items.prompt: Connect the static reports' domains: ambiguity validation, permanent eligibility latch, source qualification, diagnostic counts and reader stopping risk. Find a smallest compatible synthesis or a concrete contradiction; do not create a second improvement or judge admission.
